current_revision.mathematical_scope: Fixed SNC: lemma SNC-compatible-collars constructs exact collars preserving the given Hermitian residual norms and canonical boundary circle actions by simultaneous stratum and product-connection induction; lemma fc-collar-transfer proves flat-to-all-orders extension and Hessian comparison in the full-residual fc norms; lemma RZ-collar-tensor combines RZ Theorem 5.1 and the background formula to yield exponent min(1,nu), and finite iteration yields smooth/exponential volume-IRFA. This chain and both explicit collar obstructions received independent internal readings. No new analytic hypothesis is imposed on the ample SNC application.

No new verification of family-uniform CP/PBE/TC, H_loc/H_anc, or controlled push-off. No formal proof or exhaustive novelty check.
